items.title: Why this oil pullback could be a buying opportunity
items.summary: Oil prices (CL=F, BZ=F) are pulling back as the U.S. and Iran pause military strikes. Tortoise senior portfolio manager & managing director Rob Thummel joins Market Catalysts to discuss the volatility of oil prices and why he sees long-term value in energy stocks.

items.title: Baker Hughes Jumps On Higher Outlook As AI-Powered Orders Explode
items.summary: Baker Hughes crushed earnings estimates for the second quarter as AI-fueled orders swelled. Baker Hughes stock surged above a key level on Monday, while oil stocks broadly fell. Along with its Q2 report, Baker Hughes raised guidance based on a key segment tied to artificial intelligence (AI) data centers.

items.title: Oil Prices Slide as Trump Touts Possible Negotiations With Iran
items.summary: Oil prices fell sharply Monday as strikes between the U.S. and Iran remained paused for a third day and President Donald Trump told reporters aboard Air Force One there was a “good chance that something good could happen” with Iran.  The price of most-active  Brent crude  futures, the international benchmark, settled down 12% to $86.49 a barrel Monday.  West Texas Intermediate  the U.S. standard, settled down 7.5% at $82.61 a barrel.
